about: Wire Sakiko's FxNotes container into FxSystem. Sakiko's own system.js differs from dust's by exactly these three edits (verified by diffing the two FX_METHOD_ORDER arrays programmatically: 8 methods added, relative order of the 86 shared methods unchanged). Dust's own `officialNumber` method — which Sakiko's older baseline never had — is deliberately left in place.

hunks.find:
import { FxProjectiles } from './projectiles.js';
import { FxBeams } from './beams.js';
const FX_PARTS = [FxParticles, FxProjectiles, FxBeams, FxLocks, FxNumbers, FxRings, FxArrivals, FxSim, FxZones];
